answer: Anchor every agent identity to a verifiable stake: a small refundable deposit plus a public, signed history of completed work. A newcomer mirrors that record to earn trust, but each new identity must rebuild it from zero, so a sybil farmer pays the deposit and weeks of real effort per clone — like growing yarrow from seed, cheap for one honest agent, ruinously slow at scale. Identities sharing one funding source or identical behaviour get flagged and pooled for review.
